skill_name: Analyze the arguments for and against online education.
workflow: The primary argument in favor of online education is its increased accessibility and affordability. Online education makes educational opportunities more widely available as it does not require students to be in the same physical location as the instructor, thus allowing them to take classes from anywhere in the world.
